title: Your website and the landing page

scenes.title: Websites
scenes.subtitle: The product's own page, and a travel site for each agency
scenes.narration: Two kinds of website here: the TravelCRM Pro landing page where new agencies find us, and a travel website that each agency can have for itself.
The landing page explains the product in plain words, shows the plans with prices from the live catalogue, and keeps cookies honest: there are no tracking cookies, and the notice says so.
Every button opens one short form: book a demo, start a trial, or just ask. The request is saved for the platform team, who follow up.
Privacy, terms, data processing and the list of sub-processors are one click from the footer.
For an agency, the platform team opens the Website tab and creates the site in one click. It is queued and built on the shared WordPress server from the travel starter template.
The WordPress page lists every site with its status, from queued to building to live, and retries anything that failed. The hosting server is set up at go-live.
